title: Service Guarantee Schedule: Short-Notice Closing Credits on a Mortgage Loan File
content:
Larkspur adds a short-notice credit to the initial Closing Disclosure of a Mortgage Loan File when the scheduled closing date is close to the day the Closing Disclosure is prepared, counted in calendar days from the preparation day to the closing date currently scheduled on the file.

| Scheduled closing date, calendar days after the day the Closing Disclosure is prepared | Credit added |
|---|---|
| 7 or fewer | 100.00 USD |
| more than 7, up to and including 10 | 50.00 USD |
| more than 10 | nothing |
| no scheduled closing date on or after the preparation day | nothing |

**Clause.** Where the scheduled closing date is 7 or fewer calendar days after the day the Closing Disclosure is prepared, 100.00 USD is added; where it is more than 7 but no more than 10 calendar days after, 50.00 USD is added; where it is later than that, or the file has no scheduled closing date on or after that day, nothing is added.

## Band edges (hypothetical preparation day 3 March)

| Scheduled closing date | Days after | Credit |
|---|---|---|
| 10 March | 7 | 100.00 USD |
| 11 March | 8 | 50.00 USD |
| 13 March | 10 | 50.00 USD |
| 14 March | 11 | nothing |
